name: text-to-canonical
description: Near-structured value-chain text to canonical WardleyMap. Step 1 lints the source (LLM, deterministic short-circuits; input { text, target: 'json'|'owm' }, default json = lossless with colors/evolvesTo/inertia/pipelines/method/context/custom phases via renderConfig, schema-constrained when the provider supports `structured`); step 2 deterministically parses the DSL (owm target) and captures // key: value study-context headers. The AI layer is cosmetic: the deterministic schema/parser has the final word. On the json target the map is already in $.linted.result.map and the parse step degrades gracefully (no dsl input).
